tagline: Becoming the best bank for customers
hero_kpi_rationale: Return to profitability with underlying profit doubling to £6.2 billion, reflecting structural improvement in group performance

kpis.name: Underlying Profit
kpis.explanation: Operating profit adjusted for exceptional items, reflecting core economic performance of the group.
kpis.description: Underlying profit more than doubled to £6.2 billion, demonstrating substantial improvement in group profitability driven by cost reduction and revenue growth.

kpis.name: Underlying Income
kpis.explanation: Total revenues adjusted for exceptional items, showing core economic growth.
kpis.description: Underlying income increased 2% to £18.8 billion, demonstrating moderate but stable growth in a challenging market environment.

kpis.name: Operating Costs
kpis.explanation: Total operating expenses of the group, indicator of operational efficiency.
kpis.description: Operating costs declined 5% to £9.6 billion, reflecting an optimization and organizational simplification strategy.

kpis.name: Statutory Profit
kpis.explanation: Profit before tax calculated under IFRS accounting standards, including exceptional items.
kpis.description: The group recorded statutory profit before tax of £415 million in 2013, marking a return to profitability after several years of losses.

kpis.name: First-Time Buyer Mortgages
kpis.explanation: Number of mortgage loans granted to first-time homebuyers, indicator of mortgage market penetration.
kpis.description: The group originated over 80,000 mortgages to first-time buyers in 2013, demonstrating strong presence in the UK mortgage market.

kpis.name: Community Investment
kpis.explanation: Annual amount dedicated to community investments and social causes.
kpis.description: The group invested £85 million annually in community initiatives, placing it among the largest community investors in the UK.

kpis.name: Total Employees
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees across the group.
kpis.description: The group continues to streamline its workforce for improved efficiency, with a 2% reduction to 75,300 employees.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €944.07 billion in latest year

risks.title: Increased competition in banking services
risks.score_rationale: Risk is mentioned in the 'Risk overview' section with moderate language on competitive pressure. Central position in document, medium language intensity, stable trend, and 'Competition' is strategic category for retail banking.

risks.title: Dependence on strict financial regulation
risks.score_rationale: Risk is prominently featured in 'Risk overview' and 'Regulatory environment' sections with alarmist language on compliance costs and complexity. High document position, high language intensity, increasing trend, critical category.

risks.title: Cyberattacks and technology failures
risks.score_rationale: Risk is explicitly cited in 'Emerging risks' with strong language on growing threats. High position, high intensity, upward trend, critical category for financial services.

risks.title: Reputation damaged by past practices
risks.score_rationale: Risk is discussed in 'Chairman's statement' with language marked by PPI provisions. High position, high intensity, stable trend, significant category.

risks.title: Dependence on brand value and customer loyalty
risks.score_rationale: Risk is implicit in 'Business model' section with moderate language on multi-brand strategy. Medium position, moderate intensity, stable trend, secondary category.

risks.title: Risks related to TSB separation
risks.score_rationale: Risk is mentioned in 'Chairman's statement' with concerned language on Project Verde follow-up. High position, high intensity, increasing trend, significant category.
